title: Entwicklung einer Methode zum Einsatz von Reinforcement Learning für die dynamische Fertigungsdurchlaufsteuerung
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: This work aims to develop a method that can reschedule the matrix production in the case of a disruption. For this purpose, different artificial intelligence methods are combined in a novel way. The developed method is validated on a theoretical and a real scheduling case.
